## History

Jane Ann entered into a marriage with a wealthy man for whom she felt no genuine affection. Following this decision, she ended up leading a miserable existence, described as not even having the life of a dog.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015)_
